unit_vocabulary.comparison: be sure to do sth. vs be afraid to do sth.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Be sure to read the guidelines before taking part in.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：be sure（确定）+ to do sth.（做某事） -> 一定要做某事。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Haiku is a Japanese form of poetry.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：f + orm -> 形成各种“类型；种类”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Haley Evans has always had a special place in her heart for literature.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：liter（文字）+ ature（名词后缀） -> 文字构成的艺术即“文学；文献”。

unit_vocabulary.comparison: come up with vs catch up with
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Haley came up with the idea after reading a piece of news.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：come（来）+ up（向上）+ with（带着） -> 带着新想法涌上来，即“想出；提出”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: During the interview, she told Simons from The Oakland Post.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：inter（相互）+ view（看/视角） -> 互相交流看法，即“采访；访谈”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Now his journey to space has been made into a new film called A Million Miles Away.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：jour（天/日记）+ ney -> 每一天的旅程，即“旅行；行程”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Actor Michael Peña acted the role of Hernández in the film and he had a great performance.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：act（行动） -> 在台上行动表演，即“扮演；演戏”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The sky is not the limit, space is.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：lim（边界）+ it -> 边界线，即“极限；最大量”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The program, called Riding for Focus (R4F), was organized by the nonprofit Outride.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：organ（器官/机构）+ ize（动词后缀） -> 成立机构分工协调，即“组织；筹备”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Loma Linda University had students fill out surveys before and after the program to compare their mental condition.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：fill（填满）+ out（出来） -> 把表格填满，即“填写”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The study found that there was a general increase in students' happiness after completing the cycling program.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：gen（产生/种族）+ eral -> 涵盖大多数人的，即“普遍的；总体的”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Other research shows that one in five children deal with a mental, behavioral, or emotional illness.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：behavior（行为）+ al（形容词后缀） -> “行为的”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Anything that is meaningful to you can be written.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：meaning（意义）+ ful（充满的） -> 充满意义的，即“有意义的”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Applicants can apply for this position from June 3, 2024 to July 31, 2024.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：pos（放置）+ ition（名词后缀） -> 摆放的位置，即“职位；位置”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Actor Michael Peña acted the role of Hernández in the film and he had a great performance.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：per（彻底）+ form（形式） -> 展现出完整的形式，即“演出；表演”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: That's when many young people start to experience social pressure and stress from school.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：press（按压）+ ure（名词后缀） -> 被按压的感觉，即“压力”。
